title: Book 3 — Thalia, Chapter 95
paragraphs: Now if we compare Babylonian talents with Euboïc talents, the silver amounts to nine thousand eight hundred and eighty talents; and if we reckon gold at thirteen times the value of silver, weight for weight, the gold-dust amounts to four thousand six hundred and eighty Euboïc talents. When all these are added together, the total collected as yearly tribute for Darius amounts to fourteen thousand five hundred and sixty Euboïc talents. Sums less than these I pass over and do not mention.
